name: 12208 · Albany, NY
findings: ZIP 12208 (Albany) has 117 nonprofit organizations. 64 of them (55%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 58 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12208 (Albany) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12208 (Albany) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
